description: This file is a shell script that contains tests and setup procedures for verifying 'git init' functionality. It includes various test cases to check initialization options, configurations, error handling, and edge cases in a Git repository setup context.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Verifies if a directory is a valid git repository with specific configurations (config file exists, refs directory, executable config).

methods.name: check_long_base_path
methods.description: Sets up a long path to test 'git init' handling of long directory paths.

methods.name: sep_git_dir_worktree
methods.description: Tests repository initialization with linked worktrees and separate git directories, both for absolute and relative paths.
